name: Pinger
description: How fast your connection answers, as a number and a graph, and whether a VPN is on.
author: Giuseppe
details: How fast your connection answers. The button is the latency in milliseconds, green when quick and red when slow (OFF when nothing answers). Open it for a graph of the last minutes, the average, the packets lost and whether a VPN is on.
features: Latency as the button, green to red
permissions: Opens one small connection every five seconds. No permission needed.
